sourceOccurrences.label: Site configurations and threshold conventions
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: 8FLS explains open-graph adjacency, open-root reachability, empty closed-root clusters, symmetry and connection endpoints. Fixed-list open-walk events are measurable for arbitrary vertex sets; connection and infinite-cluster measurability use countability, while the witness and finite-set escape identities do not. The nearest-neighbour integer lattice and its capped real-valued threshold appear in 8EIH, including the unit-interval bounds and evaluation at the threshold without a criticality claim. The census counts explicit named definitions and theorems, not abbreviations, instances or anonymous examples. The source retains its upstream attribution; no Lean source is copied into this article.

sourceOccurrences.label: Site association and profile monotonicity
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: Deterministic monotonicity, symmetry, transitivity and equality of connected clusters hold without countability. 9R9K supplies self and adjacent connection identities; those cylinder identities also hold for arbitrary vertex sets even though the article uses a countable probability context. AR5B gives Harris and its connection/infinite-cluster consequences. M28D gives countable profile monotonicity, homogeneous monotonicity and the zero/positive sides of the capped lattice threshold. Zero-profile and strict two-vertex examples illustrate the source witnesses. No claim of zero percolation probability at the critical parameter is made.
